setup_line: P0: 12x Walking Ballista + 48x Forest; P1: 4x Emperor of Bones + 56x Swamp. P1's Emperor trigger targets one of >=2 Walking Ballistas in P0's graveyard.
contract_line: Every player must be able to identify the exact graveyard object targeted by the trigger before responding: the two Ballista oids are distinct objects with the same name, so a name-only label cannot disambiguate them.
